approval_case.title: Ask for an opinion only where it matters
approval_case.situation: A production authentication rollout has conflicting canary evidence, while a documentation typo is obvious and harmless.
approval_case.hao_request: Ask Codex where another view would help, then move forward.
approval_case.correct_behavior: Use Codex for one independent read-only review of the authentication evidence because it can change a material rollout decision. Give Codex the canary evidence and a focused question. Fix or route the obvious documentation typo without spending a worker opinion on it. Keep the rollout pending until primary evidence and the review support a proposal.
